title: On the $b$-invariant of a normal graded ring
summary: The $b$-invariant of a normal graded ring was defined recently by Okuma, Watanabe, and Yoshida. We study this for invariant rings of finite groups, proving that it is nonpositive in the case of abelian groups, but not necessarily otherwise; more generally, we give a description of the anticanonical module for invariant rings of finite groups. Turning to infinite groups, we record the anticanonical module and the $b$-invariant for families of determinantal rings.
